subject: Pod rotation & sightline swap — consolidated plan
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 18 Jul 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Pod rotation & sightline swap — initial ask

Team —

Quick summary: CloudSummit just re-issued the final hall grid and they bumped our assigned island two lanes east to make room for an AV rig. That creates a sightline conflict for the demo pod facing the main aisle. The show ops team is willing to approve a rapid swap of two demo pods if we sign off on a revised floor plan and updated signage specs by EOD Friday.

Ask:
- Please review attached RS-fig-pod-floorplan-v3.pdf for the proposed swap (we rotate Kiosk B into the corner, shift counter heights to avoid glare).
- Approve signage_specs_v2.pdf so vendor can print new front-facing banners with alternate logos and a shorter header to avoid obstruction.
- Confirm crate_manifest_revB.xlsx for crate swap sequencing (logistics needs this for trucking).

Constraints:
- We must keep demo A running at all times during swaps (rolling swap).
- Signage must be on-site no later than 07/25.

I know this is tight — tagging Marissa & Lauren for approvals, Grace for logistics sequencing.

Thanks,
Michael
Michael Grant
Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Michael —

Thanks for the quick heads-up. I reviewed RS-fig-pod-floorplan-v3.pdf and the proposed rotation looks good from a traffic-flow perspective. Two quick notes:
- Move the demo counter 6" further from the aisle on the south side so attendees don't cluster into the walkway.
- Confirm electrical drop locations with show ops (I added an inline comment in the PDF).

Signage: signage_specs_v2.pdf looks fine, only change is reduce the mast height by 4" to comply with the new aisle sightline. I'm happy to sign off once Lauren confirms production timeline.

Marissa
